trace_type: saved explicit review request, exact authorized inputs, read batches, full visible review response and validation; not a provider wire log or hidden reasoning export
execution_mode: direct collaborative subagent; no CLI model invoked; actual model identity not independently attested
blindness: No private_mapping, old results, other reviewer, answer key, or planned result accessed. Public memo treated as a claim to check, not ground truth.
rating_method: Each response read and judged against its own dossier. Code only serializes individually enumerated decisions, copies verbatim answer/citation fields, and checks output integrity.
